name: Nanjing Sciyon Wisdom Technology Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Nanjing Sciyon Wisdom Technology Group Co., Ltd. produces and sells industrial automation and informatization products and solutions in China and internationally. The company engages in the design of building intelligent systems; the installation, modification, and repair of special equipment; power generation, transmission, and distribution services; software sales; software development; information system integration services; the sale of industrial control computers and systems; the manufacture of industrial automatic control systems and devices; the manufacture and sale of industrial automatic control equipment; and the sale of industrial automatic control system equipment.
